title: MIT engineers copied the branching patterns of leaves and dragonfly wings to 3Dprint structures
summary_full: Engineers from MIT and Northeastern University have pioneered a novel material, known as scale-rich metamaterials, distinguished by their systematically varied internal structure. These advancements enhance durability over conventional materials. Utilizing 3D printing techniques, their prototypes demonstrated superior resistance to both impacts and compression. Drawing inspiration from the pomelo's design, researchers aim to shield delicate items with a robust outer layer.
